freeze.criticalDefinition: Changed scientific assertion, causal or logical relation, qualifier, polarity, numeric identity, or unprocessed/rejected prose in final required corpus. Guard pass is not an accuracy score.
freeze.acceptance: Zero critical errors on this fixed corpus, all six dimensions evaluated; human bilingual review remains separately PENDING.
freeze.provenance: AI-authored corpus and AI assessments only. No independent human approvals; this is not population accuracy.
freeze.previousHoldout: first-holdout-failed/HOLDOUT_INFERENCE.json; FAIL; now development regression, not current acceptance

postFreezeMetadataFix.reason: Typed deterministic guard rejection and table retry aggregation. This changes outcome/retry metadata only; no changes to model, targets, terminology, or semantic guard rules. Same final corpus is rerun for metadata and exact target equality; no new claim of unseen corpus.

identifierIntegrationFix.reason: Generic opaque identifier atom protection prevents identifier-only sentences from suppressing subsequent prose. Common uppercase beginning/end words recognized in both languages. Exact capacity fixture plus unrelated identifier forms exercise real inference. No model/domain vocabulary/claim logic change.
identifierIntegrationFix.qualification: The 30-case v2 semantic holdout is rerun as final parity evidence; not falsely labeled newly unseen after this structural integration fix.

mechanicalV4Fix.reason: Unsupported/tidak didukung normalized as a bilingual lexical-negation unit with reversal guard retained; separated bounded/monotone sequence predicates activate mathematical senses contextually. Product model unchanged.
mechanicalV4Fix.qualification: Known long-run regressions, not independent semantic acceptance.

method: Ten new AI-authored acceptance paragraphs after v4 mechanical freeze, 5 domains and both directions. Not used to adjust product rules. AI-only review; no human independence claimed. Actual ONNX/WASM via Node worker, not browser evidence.
